David Fong is a general practitioner (family medicine doctor) working at [coHealth](https://www.cohealth.org.au/), Kensington site. He volunteers with Spur Afrika (child development program) in Kibera, Kenya, and Elim and Agape childrens' home (HIV and disability) in Xi'an, China.

My interests include sustainable development in low-resource populations, teaching and the uses of monitoring and evaluation in clinical practice.

## Education

- Data, Economics and Development Policy, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MITx), 2019
- Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practice (RACGP), 2001
- Diploma of Obstetrics & Gynaecology (RANZCOG), 1999
- MBBS, University of Melbourne, 1994
